name: radio-group
blurb: Accessible radio button group wrapper with consistent styling.
description: Radio group built on Radix UI with consistent border, shadow, and focus styles. Includes RadioGroup and RadioGroupItem components.
use_when: Creating mutually exclusive selection options with a clean, accessible design.
avoid_when: When you need custom styling beyond Tailwind utilities.
a11y: Built on Radix UI RadioGroup with full keyboard navigation, aria-invalid support, and focus-visible indicators.
